lead_raw_text:
The structure of CaMg14Co crystallizes in the tetragonal space group P4_2/mnm (No. 143), with a 16-atom unit cell and five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Ca and Co each coordinated by 16 neighbors (8 Co, 8 Mg) in a close-packed-like local arrangement, while Mg centers exhibit 12-neighbor, 14-neighbor, and 10-neighbor environments, the latter with a body-centered-cubic-like motif. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single 3-periodic component spanning all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations among Mg-centered 14-vertex polyhedra include corner, edge, and face sharing.
